cleanup.basis: Separate actual Kubernetes Pod/PVC list observation; private identifiers omitted.

counts.main_report_field_explanation: Historical field advances only after completed windows; unchanged. Individual terminal driver reports establish selections/completions independently.

diagnostics.sampling: Sequential owner observations, not one atomic cut.

earliest_capture_continuity.basis: Existing qualifier compares actual retained owner observations to earlier captured receipts; public private receipts remain withheld.

observed_input_interval.basis: Selected input observer span only; excludes preparation, control-only intervals and final diagnostics. Not the programme duration.

ordinary_and_boundary_observer_duration.quantile: nearest-rank p95; operator observation elapsed, not isolated native execution

original_limits.programme_timing_basis: Qualifier uses a monotonic 7200-second window. It does not export its absolute start/end; receipt and operator intervals are measured separately.

receipt_snapshot.scope: Receipt-only private snapshot during final private window. No later allocations planned; direct input completion is counted from terminal driver reports.
